zh: 塞魯士下令猶太人返國

p.src: 1  Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

ja: たせられた。そこでクロスは
にも記して、こう告げた。
en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
u.src: 1  Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

ja: 1:1 すべて大文字で表記される「主」または「神」は、神の固有名（ヘブル語「יהוה」、通常「ヤハウェ」と発音される）の訳である。
en: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 2  “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

ja: え、ユダにあるエルサレムに、ご自分のための家を
en: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
u.src: 2  “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

ja: 1:2 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。

p.src: 3  Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

ja: がともにおられるように。その者はユダにあるエルサレムへ
り、エルサレムにおられるイスラエルの
en: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.
u.src: 3  Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

p.src: 4  Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

ja: 残された者がどこに住んでいようとも、その
け、さらにエルサレムにある
en: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”
u.src: 4  Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

p.src: 5  Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem.

ja: そこで、ユダとベニヤミンの父祖の家の
たち、すなわち、エルサレムにある主の家を建てるために上るよう
en: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem.
u.src: 5  Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem.

p.src: 6  All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

ja: のほかにも、銀の器、金、品物、家畜、高価な品々を与えて彼らを支援した。
en: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.
u.src: 6  All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

p.src: 7  Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the LORD’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

ja: は、ネブカドネザルがエルサレムから
々の家に置いていた主の家の器を取り出した。
en: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the LORD’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;
u.src: 7  Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of the LORD’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

p.src: 8  even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

ja: クロスは、宝物倉の管理者ミトレダテを通してそれらを
を確かめてユダの君シェシュバツァルに
en: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
u.src: 8  even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

p.src: 9  This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

en: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,
u.src: 9  This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

p.src: 10  thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

en: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.
u.src: 10  thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

p.src: 11  All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

ja: の民がバビロンからエルサレムへ
ったとき、シェシュバツァルはこれらすべてを
en: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
u.src: 11  All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
